entries.Original:
Opens the settings window.
/friends help — Shows the complete command list.
/friends time — Shows the time until the next automatic poll.
/friends changes — Opens the changelog.
/friends test — Sends a test notification.
/friends sync — Synchronizes all friends.
/friends syncworld — Synchronizes same-world friends.
/friends syncother — Checks friends who may be on other worlds.
/friends debug on — Enables debug chat messages.
/friends debug off — Disables debug chat messages.

entries.Original: Friend Login Notifier — What's New###FriendLoginChangelog
entries.Translated: 好友登录通知 — 更新内容

entries.Original:
---------- Hotfix — Version 1.1.1.0 ----------

• Fixed all-world tracking so same-Home-World friends who move to or log in on another world can also be checked.

• A friend moving from your current world to another world is now reported as a new login, including when the change is detected during the same polling cycle.

• Login notifications now include the friend's current world whenever FFXIV provides a valid current-world value.

---------- Major Update — Version 1.1.0.0 ----------

• Added separate automatic polling modes for same-world friends and all worlds. Automatic polling remains disabled by default.

• Same-world polling refreshes the general Friend List after a newly randomized delay between 4 and 9 minutes.

• All-world polling also checks cross-world friends individually, using a newly randomized delay of 3, 4, or 5 seconds between requests. The next 4–9 minute timer begins after the final check finishes.

• Added an initial cross-world baseline to prevent false login notifications when the plugin first loads.

• Added separate buttons and commands for syncing all friends, only same-world friends, or only friends on other worlds. Command-driven cross-world syncs report progress every 10 friends.

• Replaced the old command with /friends and added help, time, changes, test, sync, syncworld, syncother, debug on, and debug off subcommands.

• Added /friends time to show the remaining time until the next automatic poll in either polling mode.

• Added optional debug messages in chat for polling activity, timers, individual requests, completed cycles, and errors.

• Expanded the settings window with polling-mode explanations, status information, synchronized checkboxes, and risk confirmation.

• Opening the Friend List manually now restarts the randomized automatic polling timer.

• Added a per-version changelog window with a Don't show again for this version option.

• Improved plugin icon support after installation.
entries.Translated:
---------- 热修复 — 版本 1.1.1.0 ----------

• 修复了全大区追踪，使同服好友转移到其他大区或登录其他大区时也能被检测到。

• 好友从你当前所在大区转移到其他大区时，现在会报告为新登录，包括在同一轮询周期内检测到该变化的情况。

• 只要 FFXIV 提供有效的当前大区值，登录通知现在会包含好友当前所在的大区。

---------- 重大更新 — 版本 1.1.0.0 ----------

• 为同服好友和全大区分别添加了独立的自动轮询模式。自动轮询默认仍为禁用。

• 同服轮询会在 4 到 9 分钟之间新随机生成的延迟后刷新通用好友列表。

• 全大区轮询还会逐个检查跨大区好友，请求之间使用新随机生成的 3、4 或 5 秒延迟。下一次 4–9 分钟计时在最后一次检查完成后开始。

• 添加了初始跨大区基准，以防止插件首次加载时出现错误的登录通知。

• 为同步所有好友、仅同服好友或仅其他大区好友添加了独立的按钮和命令。命令驱动的跨大区同步每 10 个好友报告一次进度。

• 用 /friends 替换了旧命令，并添加了 help、time、changes、test、sync、syncworld、syncother、debug on 和 debug off 子命令。

• 添加了 /friends time，用于显示任一轮询模式下距离下一次自动轮询的剩余时间。

• 添加了可选的调试聊天消息，用于显示轮询活动、计时器、单个请求、完成的周期和错误。

• 扩展了设置窗口，包含轮询模式说明、状态信息、同步复选框和风险确认。

• 手动打开好友列表现在会重新开始随机自动轮询计时器。

• 添加了按版本显示的更新日志窗口，并带有“此版本不再显示”选项。

• 改进了安装后的插件图标支持。
